title: Structured Output and Tool Chains
summary: This module provides components for generating structured outputs from LLMs, extracting information, answering questions with citations, and interacting with APIs based on schemas and tools. It includes both modern runnable interfaces and legacy chain implementations.

nodes.label: Generate Structured Output (Runnable)
nodes.title: Generate Structured Output (Runnable)
nodes.description: Creates a flexible runnable for extracting structured data from LLM responses using various OpenAI modes (functions, tools, JSON).

nodes.label: Generate Structured Output (Legacy Chain)
nodes.title: Generate Structured Output (Legacy Chain)
nodes.description: [Legacy] Creates an LLMChain to extract structured output using OpenAI function calling based on a schema.

nodes.label: Extract Data (Pydantic, OpenAI Tools)
nodes.title: Extract Data (Pydantic, OpenAI Tools)
nodes.description: Creates a runnable to extract information from text using Pydantic schemas and OpenAI tool calling, returning structured data.

nodes.label: Extract Data (Pydantic, OpenAI Functions)
nodes.title: Extract Data (Pydantic, OpenAI Functions)
nodes.description: Creates a chain to extract information from text using Pydantic schemas and OpenAI function calling, returning structured data.

nodes.label: Extract Data (Dict, OpenAI Functions)
nodes.title: Extract Data (Dict, OpenAI Functions)
nodes.description: Creates a chain to extract information from text using dictionary schemas and OpenAI function calling, returning structured data.

nodes.label: Tag Information (Pydantic, Deprecated)
nodes.title: Tag Information (Pydantic, Deprecated)
nodes.description: [Deprecated] Creates a chain to tag information from text based on a Pydantic schema using OpenAI functions.

nodes.label: Tag Information (Dict, Deprecated)
nodes.title: Tag Information (Dict, Deprecated)
nodes.description: [Deprecated] Creates a chain to tag information from text based on a dictionary schema using OpenAI functions.

nodes.label: Answer with Citations (Runnable)
nodes.title: Answer with Citations (Runnable)
nodes.description: Creates a runnable for question answering that includes fuzzy-matched citations from provided context.

nodes.label: Answer with Citations (Chain)
nodes.title: Answer with Citations (Chain)
nodes.description: Creates an LLMChain for question answering that includes fuzzy-matched citations from provided context.

nodes.label: QA with Sources Chain
nodes.title: QA with Sources Chain
nodes.description: Creates a question answering chain that returns answers along with their supporting sources.

nodes.label: Query API (OpenAPI, Deprecated)
nodes.title: Query API (OpenAPI, Deprecated)
nodes.description: [Deprecated] Creates a chain to query an API based on an OpenAPI specification using an LLM for function calls.

nodes.label: Execute API Request
nodes.title: Execute API Request
nodes.description: Internal helper function to execute HTTP requests based on parsed OpenAPI function arguments and parameters.

nodes.label: Language Model
nodes.title: Language Model
nodes.description: An external language model (LLM) or chat model that processes prompts and generates responses.

nodes.label: Prompt Template
nodes.title: Prompt Template
nodes.description: A structured template used to construct prompts for the language model, guiding its response generation.

nodes.label: Schema Definition
nodes.title: Schema Definition
nodes.description: A Pydantic BaseModel or dictionary defining the desired structure and types of the output data.

nodes.label: Runnable Interface
nodes.title: Runnable Interface
nodes.description: The core LangChain Runnable interface, enabling composable and streamable operations.

nodes.label: Chain Interface
nodes.title: Chain Interface
nodes.description: The core LangChain Chain interface, representing a sequence of operations or components.

nodes.label: OpenAPI Specification
nodes.title: OpenAPI Specification
nodes.description: An external OpenAPI specification document (YAML/JSON) describing an API's endpoints and operations.

nodes.label: HTTP Client
nodes.title: HTTP Client
nodes.description: An external HTTP client library (e.g., `requests`) used for making network requests to APIs.
